name: Transient Cyber Asset
summary: Adversaries may target devices that are transient across ICS networks and external networks. Normally, transient assets are brought into an environment by authorized personnel and do not remain in that environment on a permanent basis. Transient assets are commonly needed to support management functions and may be more common in systems where a remotely managed asset is not feasible, external connections for remote access do not exist, or 3rd…

analytics.name: Analytic 1877
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a device establishing its first network connection to Industrial Control System (ICS) application servers from an Internet Protocol (IP) address or Media Access Control (MAC) address not previously seen in the environment, immediately following a new device association event on the network. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. analytics.name: Analytic 2254
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Secure Shell (SSH) connection to an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset from a source Internet Protocol (IP) address that appeared on the ICS network within a short window and is not in the approved device inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
